description:
O medo de sofrer violência nas ruas ou dentro de casa é uma realidade cotidiana para a maioria das mulheres, mas quais estruturas alimentam esse cenário? Neste TEDx contundente, Sofia Lins e Silva discute a ascensão da cultura red pill e da "machosfera" no ambiente digital como um sintoma contemporâneo do patriarcado e sua relação direta com o aumento dos casos de feminicídio no Brasil.
   
Apoiando-se em pesquisas, referências teóricas e análises do impacto dos algoritmos nas mídias sociais, Sofia alerta para a urgência do letramento midiático e da responsabilidade coletiva. Afinal, como construir uma sociedade onde meninas não precisem apenas aprender a se proteger, mas onde o mundo aprenda a não violentá-las?    Sofia Lins e Silva é aluna da Escola Parque Gávea desde 2015. Desde criança, é apaixonada pela área da saúde. title: Ascensão da Cultura Red Pill e violência de Gênero | Sofia Lins e Silva | TEDxEscola Parque Youth

What if putting your thoughts on paper could help you understand yourself in ways you never expected?

In this personal and reflective talk, Sri Mintarti, known as Ninong, explores how journaling can become more than a writing habit. It can be a way to process emotions, untangle overthinking and make sense of life’s difficult experiences.

Drawing from her personal journey as well as her experience as a clinical psychologist, Ninong shares how writing helped her navigate self doubt and reconnect with her inner self. Inspired by the written legacies of Indonesian figures B. J. Habibie and R. A. Kartini, she reveals how expressing our deepest thoughts and feelings can open the door to greater self awareness and a new understanding of ourselves and our relationships.

title: The Inner Voice: Discovering Yourself Through Journaling | Sri Mintarti | TEDxAvicenna Cinere School

author: TEDx Talks
description: The talk is about the rigid societal expectations to act as an "iron box," forcing boys from a young age to adopt a mold of stoic, unemotional strength that severely harms their mental health and relationships. Because men are conditioned to equate vulnerability with shame, they frequently ignore warning signs, avoid seeking help, and suffer from hidden depression—contributing to a male suicide rate two to four times higher than women globally. This emotional armor not only isolates men from the warmth and communication necessary for long-term relationships, but it also strips away their psychological flexibility. To dismantle this harmful script, the talk calls for reframing therapy around practical functioning, teaching emotional literacy to young boys, and redefining heroism as the courage to be present, communicative, and human rather than permanently silent. Aristotle Vathis, MD, MSc, ECP is a psychiatrist and psychotherapist based in Athens, Greece, with training at the National
title: The "Strong" That Hunts us  | Aristotelis Vathis | TEDxDeree ACG

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this speech, Elly Andriopoulou addresses the paradox of public space management—where visitors often view rules as restrictive, yet overwhelmingly value the high-quality, inclusive environment those very rules create. Using the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center (SNFCC) as a case study, she argues that well-designed rules are not barriers to freedom, but rather essential enablers of participation, safety, and civic discourse. Rules foster belonging by communicating shared values (like environmental care and mutual respect), ensuring physical and psychological safety, and creating common accountability among diverse visitors. For rules to succeed, they must be consistently enforced, fair, open to continuous adaptation, and designed to preserve human dignity—ultimately transforming external restrictions into a shared commitment that allows a public space to truly serve everyone. title: Everything is Allowed | Elly Andriopoulou | TEDxDeree ACG

description: Achilleas argues that personal finance should be managed with the same disciplined, rule-based approach used in high-stakes fields like aviation, where checklists prevent fatal errors caused by human memory and emotion. While society provides detailed step-by-step guidance for education and careers, it leaves individuals to improvise with their money, leading to risky speculation and emotional choices. To solve this, the talk outlines five core principles rooted in decades of financial science: automate savings first to maximize compound interest, own the entire global market through low-cost ETFs for broad diversification, focus on productive assets like equities rather than non-yielding speculative tokens, minimize costs and tax drag by avoiding frequent trading and high-fee products, and trust academic research over social media advice. title: 5 personal finance rules | Achilleas Mantes | TEDxDeree ACG

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the generation we are trying to prepare for the future has something important to teach us today?
Seema Singh Puri, an educator and mother, shares three powerful lessons she learned from her daughters. From choosing to walk away from social media success to learning how to handle disappointment and reminding their mother to make space for life beyond work, these experiences challenged her understanding of parenting, success, and personal growth.
Through these stories, she explores why we must look beyond the surface, resist the urge to solve every problem for children, and trust them to find their own way. She also reminds us that even the work we love should not become the only story we live.
Her message is a reminder that wisdom does not always flow in one direction. Sometimes, the people we teach have just as much to teach us.
Look deeper. Listen harder. And stay open to learning from the next generation. Seema Singh Puri is an educator and Cambridge-accredited trainer with
title: What Our Children Can Teach Us About Life | Seema Singh Puri | TEDxCNS Pune Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Who are we when nobody needs anything from us?
As women, we often become experts at fulfilling multiple roles- as doctors, mothers, daughters, wives, leaders, and caregivers. We learn to manage responsibilities, meet expectations, and keep moving forward, even when we are exhausted. But somewhere along the way, we may begin to confuse who we are with everything we do for others.
In this deeply personal and thought-provoking talk, Dr. Bhagyashri reflects on her journey through medical training, critical care, motherhood, and the extraordinary challenges of working during the COVID-19 pandemic. These experiences led her to confront an important question: Where is the woman behind all these roles?
Through the powerful idea of choosing herself too, she explores the hidden weight of responsibility, the emotional burden of always being the strong one, and the importance of boundaries, self-awareness, and personal identity.
This talk is not about abandoning responsibilities or caring less fo
title: The Woman Behind Every Role: Remembering Who We Are | Dr. Bhagyashri Lahane | TEDxSGU

description: Cosa succede quando l’intelligenza artificiale smette di essere solo un assistente e comincia a costruire? Pierpaolo Ruttico ci porta nel mondo della Prompted Construction. Qui l’AI genera codice, progetta e dialoga direttamente con le macchine che scolpiscono, stampano in 3D, tagliano, piegano e assemblano. Il cambiamento non riguarda solo l’architettura e la costruzione. Tocca il rapporto stesso tra uomo e macchina: chi decide, chi esegue e quale ruolo resta a noi in un futuro sempre acceso. Pierpaolo Ruttico è architetto-ingegnere e ricercatore al Politecnico di Milano, dove dirige INDEXLAB, laboratorio dedicato alla sperimentazione tra architettura, progettazione computazionale e fabbricazione digitale. Dopo aver lavorato a New York per lo studio Pelli Clarke Pelli Architects, ha sviluppato una ricerca che integra algoritmi, intelligenza artificiale e robotica per ripensare il modo in cui gli edifici vengono progettati e costruiti. Con il suo lavoro esplora nuove forme di collabor
title: Prompted Construction | Pierpaolo Ruttico | TEDxLecco

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ivana Bartoletti ama l’intelligenza artificiale, ed è proprio per questo che la vuole fatta bene. Nel suo talk sposta la domanda da cosa facciamo noi con l’AI a cosa l’AI fa a noi. Pensiamo a sistemi che ricordano tutto e assistenti progettati per trattenerci e darci sempre ragione. Bartoletti ricorda che dimenticare non è un difetto ma una forma di intelligenza emotiva, e che anche la memoria di una macchina è una scelta di design: l’oblio si può progettare. La domanda finale riguarda tutti: che tipo di AI vogliamo accanto a noi? Ivana Bartoletti è una delle principali esperte internazionali di governance dell’intelligenza artificiale, privacy e uso responsabile delle tecnologie. Dirigente con una carriera internazionale, si occupa di aiutare organizzazioni e istituzioni ad affrontare le sfide etiche, sociali e giuridiche legate all’IA e alla protezione dei dati. È cofondatrice di Women Leading in AI, rete internazionale che promuove la diversità e la parità di genere nel settore tec
title: Sempre on. Ma a quale prezzo? | Ivana Bartoletti | TEDxLecco

La soluzione non è certo quella di frenare la tecnologia. Usa l’immagine del fuoco prescritto, cioè bruciare poco e sotto controllo per evitare che bruci tutto. L’invito è quello di scegliere noi, in anticipo, cosa lasciar andare per proteggere ciò che conta.
A cosa siamo disposti a rinunciare, per restare umani? Giuseppe Aceto è un esperto di etica dell’intelligenza artificiale e della robotica, docente e professionista della trasformazione digitale. Cofondatore di Relatronica e collaboratore del CERN, si occupa del rapporto tra innovazione tecnologica, società e dimensione umana. title: Fuoco Prescritto: per un'ecologia politica dell'umano | Giuseppe Aceto | TEDxLecco
